attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post. They are not a quote from anyone else.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps the antecedent ('fail to build more and more... and continue to sink money'), the firm 'will slow', associated services, and the concentration rationale. The surrounding 'very possible' hedge applies to a nearby sentence, not this one.

contract.note: Reading slower growth as a fall in year-over-year cloud revenue growth is ordinary. The contract flags that the conjunction is ambiguous. Requiring a documented withdrawal before scoring matches his conditional.

evidence.note: Microsoft disclosure dated before the post. It says CY2026 capex plans are unchanged apart from an accounting change. This shows no withdrawal and says nothing about growth afterwards.

reviews.rationale: Conditional forecast with no deadline. Nothing in the packet shows the antecedent happened, meaning hyperscalers stopping data-center expansion and lab funding. The only item shows Microsoft's investment plans continuing. With the antecedent unmet or unknown, the claim cannot be scored, and no growth period after a withdrawal exists.

attribution.note: Zitron's own assertion. He bases it on analyst estimates, but he states the conclusion himself and endorses it.

semantics.note: Keeps 'vast majority', both AI revenues and revenue growth, all three companies, and the accusation of misleading by nondisclosure. Dropping 'representative' does not change the meaning.

contract.note: Taking about 70% as the bar for 'vast majority' follows his own figures (73%, 74%, 70%+). Using the latest pre-post quarter is a reasonable choice for a current-state claim. Requiring material omission for 'misleading' is a fair reading.

evidence.note: Microsoft disclosed RPO, and bookings, with OpenAI excluded. That partly qualifies the nondisclosure charge, but it is RPO, not AI revenue or AI revenue growth shares.
Q2 2026 total AWS sales and growth only. No AI-only revenue figure and no breakdown by lab.

reviews.rationale: No item gives OpenAI and Anthropic's share of AI revenue or AI revenue growth at any of the three platforms for the target quarter. The analyst estimates he cites were not verified. Microsoft's OpenAI-excluded disclosures partly qualify the nondisclosure charge but do not settle it. Neither part of the claim can be decided from the packet.

attribution.note: Zitron's own sentence in his post.

semantics.note: Keeps the antecedent (capacity not arriving fast enough) and the firm 'can't pay'. The vague 'it' is flagged in the contract.

contract.note: The plain reading, that delayed capacity leaves the labs unable to meet compute payments, is ordinary. Measuring a delay against contracted delivery schedules is reasonable. The packet supplies no deadline, and none is invented.

evidence.note: Anthropic S-1 risk factor dated before the cutoff. It is a hedged, forward-looking warning about revenue covering commitments. It shows no capacity delay and no actual failure to pay.

reviews.rationale: Conditional with no deadline. The packet does not show that a qualifying capacity delay happened, or that either lab became unable to pay. The S-1 passage is a risk warning, not an outcome. With the antecedent unknown, the claim is not scored.

attribution.note: Zitron's own scenario in his post.

semantics.note: He gives this as one of two scenarios, so it is not a firm forecast that a lab will die. The drafter correctly makes the lab's death the antecedent. The 'half or more' threshold and the production and financing clauses are kept.

contract.note: Defining 'die' as permanent cessation and declining to treat continued operation as refutation are both fair to an undated conditional scenario.

evidence.note: OpenAI status page, dated Oct 27, 2026. Services are operating, so the antecedent has not occurred.
Anthropic release notes from October 2026 show it still operating commercially. Antecedent not met.

reviews.rationale: Both labs were operating at the cutoff, so the triggering failure has not happened. Under policy the conditional is not scored, and continued operation does not refute it. No deadline was given.
